WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) as member_sum
  FROM income
  WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_sum) as grand_total
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.link_to_member,
    step1.member_sum,
    CAST(step1.member_sum AS REAL) / step2.grand_total as proportion
  FROM step1, step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.link_to_member,
    step3.member_sum,
    step3.proportion,
    step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as excess
  FROM step3, step4
  WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion
)
SELECT
  SUM(member_sum) as total_member_sum,
  AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM step5
